title: Build live timeline and Workforce Action Center
goal: Give managers a unified timeline, manager-status controls, and source-backed organization/department Action Center.

out: Conflating worker evidence with manager state

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Timeline merges shifts, actions, status, attendance evidence, communications, and milestones without conflating sources
Every event exposes actor, effective time, and source
Bulk status updates preview impact and identify per-worker failures
Actions reconcile against their authoritative source and deep-link correctly
